media.title: Winderman: The Boca bond endures between Heat, Erik Spoelstra, Dusty May
media.description: Erik Spoelstra has had similar Miami Heat moments before, coaching against a mentor in Stan Van Gundy and against a protege in David Fizdale. But Monday was different with Dusty May.
